ABOUT.HEADING: About the System
ABOUT.BODY: The MOHE Scholarship Management System is a comprehensive digital platform developed for the Ministry of Finance to manage all aspects of student scholarships abroad. It centralises student records, financial operations, approvals, and reporting into a single, role-secured application accessible to ministry staff.

STUDENTS.TITLE: Students
STUDENTS.DESC: Register and manage scholarship students — personal data, passport details, study status, extensions, travel tickets, and academic year results.

FINANCE.TITLE: Finance
FINANCE.DESC: Track scholarship disbursements, university fees, book allowances, loans, WAFAR reconciliation, and quarterly payment ledgers per student.

APPROVALS.TITLE: Approvals
APPROVALS.DESC: Multi-level approval workflows for data changes. Requests are routed through configurable levels; each level requires sign-off by an authorised role.

REPORTS.TITLE: Reports
REPORTS.DESC: Exportable statistical, financial, and periodic reports. Includes university-level breakdowns, custom filters, and scheduled report generation.

USER_MANAGEMENT.TITLE: User Management
USER_MANAGEMENT.DESC: Role-based access control with users, roles, groups, and fine-grained page/field permissions. Full session tracking and audit logging.

SYSTEM_ADMIN.TITLE: System Administration
SYSTEM_ADMIN.DESC: Manage lookup tables, system settings, database backups, data imports, and WAFAR spending configurations.

ACCESS.HEADING: Access & Security
ACCESS.BODY: All system modules are protected by JWT-based authentication. Access to individual pages, sections, and data fields is controlled through the User Management module. Users are assigned roles and permissions by system administrators. Every data modification is recorded in the audit log for traceability and compliance.

CODE_LISTS.TITLE: Code Lists
CODE_LISTS.DESCRIPTION: Every code list of the system: names, order, tag colours and icons. Rows the code depends on are locked.
CODE_LISTS.SYSTEM_ROW: System code: the application depends on it; it cannot be renamed, deactivated or deleted
CODE_LISTS.READ_ONLY_LIST: This list is read-only: it is served from a table maintained elsewhere.
CODE_LISTS.HOW_TO_1: A code list is one fixed set of values: the options behind a dropdown and the coloured tags shown on the screens. The application stores the code; this page decides the two names, the order, the colour and the icon it is shown with.
CODE_LISTS.HOW_TO_2: Pick a list at the top. The lists are grouped by the part of the system that uses them, and the panel below the picker says what the selected list drives.
CODE_LISTS.HOW_TO_3: Editing a name changes the wording everywhere in the application, in that language only. It never changes stored data: the code itself stays as it is.
CODE_LISTS.HOW_TO_4: To retire a code, switch its row off: it disappears from new dropdowns while the old records that already use it still read correctly. Codes are never deleted, because records may still point at them.
CODE_LISTS.HOW_TO_5: A row with a lock is a system code: the application's own code depends on its exact spelling, so it cannot be renamed or switched off.
CODE_LISTS.HOW_TO_6: A read-only list is served from a table that has its own screen; open that screen to change it. Any change made here reaches the rest of the application within a minute.
CODE_LISTS.NO_OWNER_SCREEN: No editing screen: this table is maintained directly in the database.
CODE_LISTS.HINT_CODE: The value the application stores. It is never shown to end users — the two names are.
CODE_LISTS.HINT_CODE_LOCKED: The code cannot be changed once the row exists.
CODE_LISTS.HINT_ORDER: Position in dropdowns and in this table; smaller numbers come first.
CODE_LISTS.HINT_NAMES: Both names are shown — each user sees the one for their language.
CODE_LISTS.HINT_SEVERITY: Colour of the tag this code is drawn with on the screens.
CODE_LISTS.HINT_ICON: A PrimeIcons name such as pi-check. Leave empty for no icon.
CODE_LISTS.HINT_ACTIVE: An inactive code still reads correctly on old records but is no longer offered in dropdowns.

LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.UMS_USER_STATUS: Whether a system account may sign in: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, LOCKED. Shown on user management and the profile page.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.UMS_USER_PRIVILEGE: ADMIN or REGULAR — the privilege level offered when a user is created or edited.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.UMS_ROLE_KIND: SYSTEM or CUSTOM: whether a role ships with the application or was added here.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.UMS_GROUP_KIND: SYSTEM or CUSTOM for user groups. It reads the same table as the role kind, so an edit shows in both.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.UMS_FIELD_TYPE: The input types a managed field can have: TEXT, NUMBER, DATE, BOOLEAN, SELECT. Used by field management.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.PERMISSION_RESOURCE_TYPE: What a permission protects: PAGE, SECTION, FIELD or REPORT.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.PERMISSION_ACTION_TYPE: The verbs a permission grants: SEARCH, VIEW, ADD, EDIT, DELETE, EXPORT. Their order here is the column order of the permission matrix.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.HTTP_METHOD: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH — offered when an API link or a notification webhook is registered.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.PORTAL_ACCOUNT_STATUS: State of a student's login to the student portal: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, LOCKED.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.REQUEST_TYPE: The change an approval request carries: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE. Drives the tag on approval history and pending approvals.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.APPROVAL_STATUS: Life cycle of an approval request: PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, APPROVED, REJECTED, EXECUTED.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.APPROVAL_ACTION: The steps recorded on an approval's timeline: CREATED, SUBMITTED, UPDATED, APPROVED, REJECTED, EXECUTED.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.APPROVAL_ENTITY_TYPE: The entities that go through an approval cycle, read from the approval configurations screen.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.CHANGE_REQUEST_STATUS: State of a student change request: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, MODIFIED, IN_PROGRESS, EXECUTED.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.CHANGE_REQUEST_FIELD: The student fields a change request may edit. The code is the field's name on the student record; the extra column names the lookup a dropdown field draws its options from, and is empty for a free-text field.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.INFO_REQUEST_STATUS: State of a request for information sent to a student: PENDING, OVERDUE, RESPONDED, CANCELLED.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.INFO_REVIEW_STATUS: The reviewer's verdict on a student's answer: PENDING_REVIEW, APPROVED, REJECTED.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.INQUIRY_TYPE: What a portal inquiry is about: GENERAL, ACADEMIC, FINANCIAL, DOCUMENTS, OTHER.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.INQUIRY_STATUS: State of a portal inquiry: OPEN, PENDING, RESPONDED, CLOSED.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.STUDY_STATUS: The student's study state. It is served from STUDENT_STUDY_STATUS — not from the lookup screen's own STUDY_STATUS table, which is a different list.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.MINISTRY_TYPE: The ministry or agency that sent the student, served from STUDENT_MINISTRY_TYPE.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.UNIVERSITY_TYPE: The kind of university a student attends, served from STUDENT_UNIVERSITY_TYPE.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.FIN_RECEIVED_STATUS: State of a student's received-finance record, served from STUDY_FIN_RECEIVED_STATUS.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.PAY_FEE_STATUS: State of a university-fee payment, served from STUDY_PAY_FEE_IN_STATUS.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.EXTENSION_TYPE: The kinds of study extension (academic, financial, administrative, special circumstance), served from EXTENSION_TYPE.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.EXTENSION_STATUS: State of a study-extension request, served from EXTENSION_STATUS.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.TRAVEL_TYPE: The kinds of travel ticket a student may be issued, served from LU_TRAVEL_TYPE.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.DEATH_PROCEDURE: The steps a death case runs through: notify the family, suspend payments, notify the university, collect the death certificate, close the financial file, final report.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.SEMESTER_NUMBER: Semesters 1 to 12, offered wherever a semester is chosen.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.ACADEMIC_YEAR: The academic years selectable on reports and student records.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.PAYMENT_AUTH_STATUS: State of a payment authorisation: DRAFT, APPROVED, PAID.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.PAYMENT_AMOUNT_SOURCE: Where a payment's amount comes from: FINANCE, WAFAR or UNIVERSITY_FEE.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.ACCOUNT_NATURE: The five natures of a chart-of-accounts account. The extra column is the side the account's normal balance sits on.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.LOAN_STATUS: State of a student loan: pending, approved, repaid, cancelled. The codes are the numbers stored on the loan record.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.BOOKS_ALLOWANCE_PAY_STATUS: Pending, paid or cancelled; the codes are the numbers stored on the allowance record.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.UNIVERSITY_FEE_STATUS: Pending, paid, overdue or cancelled; numeric codes, as stored on the fee record.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.FEE_SOURCE: Who funds the university fee: Wafar, the ministry, a transfer from another field, or another university fee.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.FEE_CHECK_PAYOR: Whether the cheque is made out to the student or paid to the university directly.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.FEE_TYPE: The fee catalogue, served from FINCORE.FEE_TYPE.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.WAFAR_BENEFICIARY_TYPE: Who receives the Wafar payment: the student, the ministry, cultural affairs, or another party.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.QUARTER_NUMBER: Quarters 1 to 4, used by quarterly disbursement and the statistical reports.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.ALERT_SEVERITY: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW — the colour and the order of alert badges across the dashboards.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.ALERT_TYPE: INFO, WARNING, ERROR, SUCCESS — the kind of message an alert scenario raises.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.NOTICE_STATUS: ACTIVE, RESOLVED, DISMISSED — the state of a dashboard notice.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.NOTIFICATION_SCOPE: One recipient, a filtered group, or everyone.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.REPORT_LABEL: The words printed on generated PDFs: "Generated", "Page", "of", the quarter ordinals, the report titles. Editing a name here changes the wording on the report itself.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.GRAPH_CATEGORY: The branches of the student graph. The extra column is the hex colour the branch is drawn in.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.BOOLEAN_FILTER: The two options of an active-or-inactive filter dropdown: true means active, false means inactive.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.VISIBILITY_FILTER: The two options of a visible-or-hidden filter dropdown: yes means visible, no means hidden.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.STATUS_ACTIVE: The active flag as it is stored where the column is numeric: 1 is active, 0 is inactive.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.YES_NO: The two options of a yes-or-no dropdown.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.SCHEDULE_STATUS: ACTIVE or PAUSED — the state of a scheduled job.
LIST_DESCRIPTIONS.RUN_STATUS: RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED — the outcome of a job run.
